lead_raw_text:
The structure of Rb2Mg2Ag2O6 (reduced formula RbMgAgO3) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag and Mg each coordinated by four O neighbors, while Rb exhibits a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 O neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Ag and Mg 4-vertex polyhedra and Rb 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Rb 12-vertex polyhedra; the geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component.
